Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase normally comes before the main action verb in this pattern: “like + place + action.” [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，The verb “pretend” needs a form such as this before an action; the original word cannot directly introduce the action in this meaning. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a recently mentioned character when no other singular male character competes as the referent. [rule: reference_form]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence of the same character. [rule: reference_form]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is a completed move in the past, so the final action takes 了 to mark completion. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在“玩”前面，改为“喜欢在墓地里玩”正确。
“装祭拜”搭配不对；“假装祭拜”是正确的替代说法。
孟子刚在前句出现，没有其他男性人物竞争指称时，应使用“他”。
孟子是近距离再次出现的同一人物，应改用“他五岁的时候”。
搬家是已经完成的过去事件，应用“搬了家”标记完成。
